decisions.reason: Despite its initial flagship status, the product's narrow citrus focus and lack of observed website presence after 2019 make it more likely that we would now redeploy resources to broader reusable-packaging opportunities.
A foldable large-container line remains close to our core returnable transport-packaging business, so even without recent observed promotion it is still likely to justify continued support.
Stackable plastic crates fit our standard reusable-packaging portfolio, and although the limited later visibility raises some doubt, the category is still commercially relevant enough to retain.

The spill-retention pallet line is more specialized than our main logistics-packaging range and its disappearance from observed website materials suggests resources are better shifted to stronger core lines or new development.
This pallet variant still complements our established pallet offering and can plausibly remain as a niche customer-specific option even if it is no longer heavily marketed.
